turns.instruction: Build the two-story triangular prism using connection table A and analyze. Report Ux, Uz, Uy at A2=(0,0,6)m, all three reactions at A0, and signed axial force in first base rod hAB0. Include node/member location, signs, units, case D and turn. Preserve raw OpenSees run evidence for each state.

Replace only upper-tier diagonals dAB2 and dBC2 using table B: dAB2 becomes B1-A2; dBC2 becomes C1-B2. Keep every other member, section, restraint and load, then rerun. Report Ux, Uz, Uy at A2=(0,0,6)m, all three reactions at A0, and signed axial force in first base rod hAB0. Include node/member location, signs, units, case D and turn. Preserve raw OpenSees run evidence for each state.

Undo only the two diagonal replacements. Restore connection table A exactly and rerun. Report Ux, Uz, Uy at A2=(0,0,6)m, all three reactions at A0, and signed axial force in first base rod hAB0. Include node/member location, signs, units, case D and turn. Preserve raw OpenSees run evidence for each state.
